verdict.headline: Rey Cortiço Lunch
verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY I’d head to Rey Cortiço for the lunch window, but only after a cam check—Surfline looks a bit unreliable today, so it could easily be messy. The wind is usable but cross-on and the waves are on the small side, so the sandbanks will really decide if it’s worth the session. Before you leave, check Surfline cams and MEO Beachcam for Rey Cortiço and go only if it’s clearly cleaner than you’re expecting.

best.explanation: Rey Cortiço looks like a small north coast window for Rare window, Low confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 31 kJ, 6 s period, lully 0/100, and wind is not fully clear.  An open beach break where the sandbanks decide everything; this is best for quiet, punchy peaks when Lagide is too small; 6-9s at mid tide can turn Belgas punchy and rippable, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully.

ranked.explanation: Cerro looks like a fun-sized window for Too soft, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 42 kJ, 7 s period, lully 5/100, and wind is not fully clear.  A sheltered beachbreak with gentle lefts and rights, somewhat similar to Cantinho but less consistent; this is best for manageable bodyboard waves when north-northwest swell reaches the bay with clean southerly wind; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; Cerro may feel too soft without more push.
ranked.shortExplanation: Cerro is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  It looks too soft to make the drive worthwhile.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
warnings: Cerro may feel too soft without more push
